messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating canary for release v3.20 to canary-global (group=5). Change window 2026-05-02 08:00-09:00 UTC. Release notes: https://internal.redwood.dev/releases/v3.20 PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/789
harper: Quick ask — link to backout/runbook + who owns rollback for this canary? Also share the hotpin sample.
leo: Backout/runbook: https://confluence.redwood.dev/display/OPS/Backout-v3.20-kinetic. I'll take rollback ownership for canary. Hotpin sample: `rdeploy hotpin --cluster canary-global --image redwood:v3.19 --duration 25m --threshold p95=210ms`
sre-bot: Alert rules set: p95 >200ms for 4m OR 5xx >0.6% for 2m -> auto-pause. Adding a Grafana watch: https://grafana.redwood.dev/d/alerts/9012
ops-automation: Quick auto-ops helpers: dual-region pin: `rdeploy pin --clusters canary-eu,canary-us --image redwood:v3.19 --note "temp pin during canary" --duration 30m`. Cache purge helper: `opsctl cache purge --target canary --type prefix --pattern "session:*"`
harper: Please paste a compact rollback checklist here (one-liner steps) so oncall can copy quickly. :point_down:
leo: Rollback checklist (copyable):
1) `rdeploy rollback --to-tag redwood:v3.19 --cluster canary-global`
2) `kubectl rollout restart deployment/edge-proxy -n redwood`
3) Purge edge-prefix caches: `opsctl cache purge --target canary --type prefix --pattern "session:*"`
4) Invalidate KV-store local indexes: `kvtool repair --host kv-canary --mode quick`
5) Verify db-migrator logs for schema errors: `kubectl logs -n redwood -l app=db-migrator | grep -i error`
6) Notify product + reopen change window if a reattempt is planned.
oncall-bot: Rollback owner assigned: leo. Pager: +1-555-0606. Escalation: oncall -> eng-sre -> eng-platform.
deploy-bot: Canary progress: 1/5 OK, 2/5 OK, 3/5 degraded (p95=215ms) -> auto-pause triggered by rule `p95 > 200ms`. Holding further rollouts.
harper: Auto-pause seen. Leo, do we hotpin, staged pin, or full rollback?
leo: Looking at metrics: p95 spike concentrated on edge routing in eu. 5xx remain low. I'll try an eu-only hotpin first to reduce blast radius: `rdeploy hotpin --cluster canary-eu --image redwood:v3.19 --duration 20m` then re-evaluate in 5m.
deploy-bot: Hotpin executed by leo at 2026-05-02T08:07:10Z.
sre-bot: Post-hotpin metrics: eu p95 back to 120ms, global p95 ~110ms. No DB errors. Recommend 10m observation before resuming.
harper: Good mitigation. If this reappears or DB errors surface, follow full rollback checklist. Product looped for release note edits if we end up rolling back.
product-bot: Product team acknowledged. Will prepare rollback blurb in case we revert.
leo: Monitoring. If eu re-degrades or 5xx crosses 0.6% I'll run full rollback to v3.19 across canary-global.
deploy-bot: Status update at 2026-05-02T08:13:50Z: all canary groups stable. No rollback executed.
harper: Thanks everyone. Please add a brief postmortem note to the release ticket with the mitigation timeline and decide on a reattempt cadence. Closing thread after release-ticket update.
